summary: Built 3 demo pages for a TaskFlow project management product: landing page with hero section, feature highlights, stats, and CTA; Project Boards feature page with realistic project data table (8 sample projects with progress bars, status badges, and priority indicators); and Analytics feature page with metrics dashboard and project breakdown cards. Updated base layout with full navigation menu and structured footer. Added responsive CSS for mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports with a mobile hamburger menu. Created SVG placeholder images and sample data JSON with 8 realistic project records. All pages use valid HTML5 with semantic elements, ARIA attributes, alt text, and proper heading hierarchy.
